name: 01-rack
title: The Rack
voiceover: K-Ball is 15-ball rotation. Rack all 15 balls with stripes and solids alternating: the 1-ball on the apex, the 8-ball in the center of the rack, and the 15-ball on the back-center. Cue ball is placed anywhere behind the head string for the break.

name: 02-legal-break
title: Legal Break
voiceover: A legal break requires a minimum of three balls to cross the head string, or be pocketed. If not, it's a foul.

name: 03-break-results
title: Break Results
voiceover: If a ball is pocketed on a legal break, the breaker continues shooting from wherever the cue ball lies on the table. If no balls are pocketed on the break, the incoming player gets ball in hand.

name: 04-rotation-and-calling-pockets
title: Rotation & Calling Pockets
voiceover: You must hit the lowest-numbered ball on the table first. Every single pocket must be called explicitly before the shot.

name: 05-miss-penalty
title: Miss Penalty
voiceover: After any missed shot, your opponent receives cue ball in hand — they can place the cue ball anywhere on the table.

annotations.label: MISS → opponent gets ball in hand ANYWHERE

name: 06-no-safety-play
title: No Safety Play
voiceover: Safety play is strictly prohibited under standard K-Ball guidelines. Every shot must be an honest attempt to pocket the called ball.

annotations.label: NO SAFETIES — you must play to pocket

name: 07-scoring
title: Scoring
voiceover: Every legally pocketed ball counts as one point. Matches are typically played to a target score: 25 balls for recreational play, 35 for professional.

name: 08-continuing-the-game
title: Continuing the Game
voiceover: Once all 15 balls are cleared from the table, they are re-racked, and the player who pocketed the final ball breaks the next rack.

annotations.label: All 15 cleared → re-rack, last pocketer breaks

name: 09-finishing-the-game
title: Finishing the Game
voiceover: Play continues until a player reaches their point goal. The winning player may also keep shooting past their goal to work on their high run.

annotations.label: Win = reach target score.  Bonus: high-run practice.
